name: xlwings Excel MCP Server
description: Enables Excel file manipulation through Microsoft's official COM automation interface using xlwings, designed for corporate environments where security policies prevent direct file access. Provides 25 tools for workbook operations, data manipulation, formatting, charts, pivot tables, and worksheet management through native Excel integration.
